# Aadil Kamal Khan

> AI/ML engineer and full-stack developer from Chitral, Pakistan. Computer Science graduate (IMSciences Peshawar, 2026). Builds AI products end to end under the name SpecOne. Core idea: guarantees live in code, not in a prompt.

Contact: adilkamalkhan3@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aadil-kamal-khan-ai. GitHub: https://github.com/aadilkk18.

## Projects
- [Kairos](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/kairos.html): AI decision-intelligence platform in development. A quantitative engine computes every number; the language model only explains results.
- [Spinzar Gems Co.](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/spinzar.html): luxury gemstone showcase and inquiry platform for a client, built solo, live.
- [LEO](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/leo.html): offline personal AI assistant with Khowar language memory, runs on 8GB RAM with no GPU. Core complete, paused.
- [KhimiYaar AI](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/khimiyaar.html): health information chatbot with a lab report analyzer, emergency detection and an X-ray fracture model.
- [HireLens](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/hirelens.html): CV rating platform tuned to Pakistani hiring, hybrid OCR, semantic matching across 115+ roles.
- [SRMS / DineNest](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/srms-dinenest.html): multi-tenant restaurant management system, final year project, team of three.
- [Mirror](https://aadilkk18.github.io/portfolio/work/mirror.html): offline Android game with an opponent that learns how you choose; hand-written learning engine, no ML library. Nearly finished.
